title: 上海高考高分翻译背诵-100-24一模

items.zh: 两个小朋友分别得到一盒蜡笔和一本书作为奖励。
items.en: The two children were rewarded with a box of crayons and a book respectively.

items.zh: 一个人名利心越重，就越不可能脚踏实地做事。
items.en: The more desperate one is for fame and fortune, the less likely one is to settle down to real work.

items.zh: 他的古画修复水平如此之高，使得那幅尘封已久的画作重现光彩。
items.en: His skill in restoring ancient paintings is such that he restored the long-sealed painting to its former glory.

items.zh: 许多年过去了，他才渐渐淡忘人生中那尴尬的一幕:在大庭广众之下，他看到血晕倒了。
items.en: It was not until many years later that he gradually came to forget the embarrassing moment where he fainted at the sight of blood in public.

proverb.en: Moreover, a few glimmers of hope can be discerned amid the gloom.
proverb.zh: 然而透过阴霾，仍然可以看见一丝曙光。
